relations.subject: Arthur Anthony Macdonell
relations.evidence: He was educated at Göttingen University

relations.subject: Arthur Anthony Macdonell
relations.evidence: matriculated in 1876 at Corpus Christi College, Oxford, gaining a classical exhibition and three scholarships... He graduated with classical honours in 1880

relations.subject: Arthur Anthony Macdonell
relations.evidence: was appointed Taylorian Teacher of German (language) at Oxford.

relations.subject: Arthur Anthony Macdonell
relations.evidence: In 1883 he obtained his PhD from the University of Leipzig

relations.subject: Arthur Anthony Macdonell
relations.evidence: became Deputy Professor of Sanskrit at Oxford in 1888

relations.subject: Arthur Anthony Macdonell
relations.evidence: Boden Professor of Sanskrit in 1899 (a post that carried with it a fellowship of Balliol College, Oxford).
